app.name: Kornucopia

board.noteStyle: Sticky notes to organize your work.
card.label: CARD
card.title: Title
card.removed: This card was removed from the board.
card.deleteConfirmation: Delete this card? You can restore it with Undo (⌘Z).
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: Choose the interface language. Your cards keep their original text.
settings.wipDescription: WIP means work in progress. Choose how many cards can be in Doing at once.
settings.wipTip: When you reach the limit, finish a card and move it to Review. Keep new ideas in Backlog.
settings.invalidLimit: Use a whole number of at least {limit}. The limit must accommodate the current cards.
settings.wipUpdateError: The limit could not be changed.
wip.title: Work in progress limit
wip.body:
Doing already has {limit} cards, the current limit.

Finish a card and move it to Review before starting another. Keep new ideas in Backlog.

You can increase the limit in Settings.
a11y.wipMaximum: Maximum number of cards in Doing
a11y.wipAdjust: Increase or decrease the WIP limit
a11y.cardOpenHint: Opens the card for editing. You can also drag it to another column.
a11y.cardUsageHint: Click to edit. Drag to move. Right-click for more options.
a11y.doingCount: {count} cards out of a limit of {limit}
error.save: Could not save the board. Your cards remain open. {detail}
error.preservePrimary: The board file has an error. A copy could not be preserved, so saving is paused. {detail}
error.preserveBackup: Could not preserve the board backup. Saving is paused. {detail}
error.unsupportedVersion: This file version is not yet supported by the app.
error.duplicateIdentifiers: The file contains cards with duplicate identifiers.
error.invalidWIPLimit: The file contains an invalid work in progress limit.
error.terminationTitle: The latest changes have not been saved
error.terminationBody:
The app could not save the board. Keep it open to try again.

{detail}
recovery.title: Board recovery
recovery.previous: The previous file had an error. A copy was kept for recovery.
recovery.backupPrevious: The previous backup had an error. The file was kept for recovery.
recovery.backupRecovered: The board was restored from the latest backup. The previous file is kept in the app’s data folder.
recovery.unreadable: The board files had an error. The files that could be preserved are kept in the app’s data folder.
column.backlog.title: Backlog
column.backlog.subtitle: Ideas to work on
column.backlog.emptyHelp: Create a card to get started.
column.backlog.tutorial.title: Collect and choose ideas
column.backlog.tutorial.step1: Create a card for each idea or task.
column.backlog.tutorial.step2: Write down the expected outcome and reorder priorities.
column.backlog.tutorial.step3: Keep work that has not started here.
column.backlog.tutorial.next: Next: move a priority to Doing when there is room.
column.doing.title: Doing
column.doing.subtitle: Active work
column.doing.emptyHelp: Work on up to {limit} cards at a time.
column.doing.tutorial.title: Focus your work
column.doing.tutorial.step1: Keep up to {limit} cards in active work.
column.doing.tutorial.step2: Update the notes as you work.
column.doing.tutorial.step3: At the limit, advance a card before starting another.
column.doing.tutorial.next: Next: move to Review when the work is ready.
column.review.title: Review
column.review.subtitle: Editing and feedback
column.review.emptyHelp: Bring a card here to edit and review.

column.review.tutorial.step1: Review the result against your plan.
column.review.tutorial.step2: Record changes and feedback in the notes.
column.review.tutorial.step3: If more work is needed, return to Doing when there is room.
column.review.tutorial.next: Next: move to Done after the final check.
column.done.title: Done
column.done.subtitle: Completed work
column.done.tutorial.title: Keep completed work
column.done.tutorial.step2: Keep the result and notes for future reference.
column.done.tutorial.step3: Reorder or delete cards when you choose to tidy the board.

app.alreadyOpen: Kornucopia is already open. Use the existing window.
storage.editRejected: This change was not saved. The board keeps its last accepted content. Reduce the text or number of notes to continue; rejected text stays in the editor while it remains open.
settings.storageLimits: Resource protection: up to 10,000 notes per board, 16 MiB per file and 8 MiB of total UTF-8 text.
error.storageFileType: The board must be a regular file without links or references to another file.
error.storageFileSize: The board file exceeds the 16 MiB safety limit.
error.storageCardCount: The board exceeds the 10,000-note safety limit.
error.storageFieldSize: A field exceeds its UTF-8 text limit: board name 1 KiB, note title 4 KiB or notes 256 KiB.
error.storageTextBudget: Total board text exceeds the 8 MiB UTF-8 safety limit.
error.storageStructure: The file structure exceeds the depth or reading-work limits.
error.storageChanged: The board file changed outside this app. Saving is paused to preserve that other version. Keep any pending text before reopening the app.
error.unsavedDraftBody: This text exceeds the board limits and has not been saved. Adjust it to save, or copy the draft before closing.
error.copyDraft: The draft could not be copied. The editor remains open.
error.preferencesBudget: The preferences exceed the safety limits or use a rejected file type. The file allows 64 KiB and search allows 4 KiB of UTF-8 text.
error.preferencesChanged: The preferences changed outside this app. Saving is paused to preserve that other version.
